work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go (Gin) for Turbot Guardrails, secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and integrated it as a gRPC client for internal microservices.
Led AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas, reducing policy-code duplication ~60% and unblocking Node.js runtime upgrades.
Built a Kafka-based event-driven pipeline with asynchronous consumers and dead-letter-queue handling to process policy-enforcement events reliably at scale.
Re-architected 35+ cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and reducing API throttling issues.
Optimized PostgreSQL audit queries using JSONB and multi-stage CTE rewrites, improving performance 40% (from 3 minutes to 1.5 minutes) across 10,000+ resources.
Authored multi-cloud compliance modules in HCL + SQL across AWS, Azure, GCP, M365, Google Workspace, and GitHub standards, reducing enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.
Added multi-distro Linux smoke tests to GitHub Actions release pipelines, improving CI/CD reliability before deployment.

Owned release engineering for four open-source products (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe), including unified GitHub Actions workflows, GHCR Docker tagging, and shipped shared-library enhancements.
